messages.author: 8c459064ae20d4ad
messages.subject: Microsoft R Services MKL
parts:
Hi all! I was checking Microsoft R Services MKL End User License Agreement and I found this:

"R Services MKL is a software package provided for use with Microsoft R Server, Revolution R Enterprise, and any successors or other software applications released by us ("Licensed Products") that can be used with the Intel® Math Kernel Libraries ("MKL")...",

so, I'm wondering if this means I cannot use MKL with MRO. Can anyone help me clarify?

Regards.

messages.author: 829e33684ea2ecd2
messages.subject: Re: Microsoft R Services MKL
parts:
Hi Nicolas,

I agree that the wording is a bit confusing here. We will change this so it explicitly mentions Microsoft R Open.
The current MKL license however does cover Microsoft R Open for use by all customers.


Stephen Weller
Microsoft R Open Technical Support
